subtitle: Lesson 28 · System Properties, Scheduled Jobs & Logs

code:
"SLA breach warnings used to show up right away.
 Lately they're 20-30 minutes late.
 Nothing on the form changed.
 No ACL or Business Rule was touched."
caption: A performance complaint — worked by configuration, then history, then log.

steps.label: Identify the suspect
steps.sub: a Scheduled Job sweep, not a single-record Business Rule

steps.label: Check the property
steps.sub: a changed interval or batch-size setting could explain the lag alone

steps.label: sys_updated_on
steps.sub: a recent change timestamp on the property is a strong lead

steps.label: Next action
steps.sub: when the job is due to run next, compared to the expected interval

steps.label: Run history
steps.sub: a 5-minute job taking 25 minutes to run backs up exactly like this

steps.label: System Log, anchored
steps.sub: filter Errors or Script Log Statements to that run's exact window

code:
Changed property?        -> restore or re-tune the value
Runs simply slower?      -> adjust interval / batch size, or escalate capacity
Neither?                 -> only then suspect the script itself
caption: Slow and working is not the same problem as silently failing.
